name: attack-surface-planner
description: Offline authorized-scope reconciliation and passive attack surface test planning.

interface.longDescription: Reconcile a signed-off rules-of-engagement manifest with pinned local Azure, Entra, DNS/CT, and endpoint exports. Produce attributed scope decisions and passive test proposals. No network or tenant API calls.
defaultPrompt: Build an offline, scope-first attack surface review plan from my approved local manifest and exports.
